tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.quote: The only Gen-AI tool that the University currently allows staff and students to sign-up to with their University credentials is Microsoft Copilot in Edge.
You should be aware that there are risks associated with using any Gen-AI tool, especially those that they are signing up to without the University’s explicit knowledge and support.

data.quote: Gen-AI tools may collect user data. Read privacy policies carefully and avoid sharing Personal, sensitive or copyright protected information.
